clientState.workbenchPaging: Review and category lists page 50 transactions, including pending lists, with total matching the tab transaction count; shared issue decisions keep their original complete member scope. Clients fill one visible page from bounded transport fragments; only the final page may be shorter. Exclusions page batch-wide group summaries first; one expanded group pages its transactions in batches of 50 without splitting the account card. Page navigation commits after every fragment succeeds; evidence and other member paging keep their own bounds.
clientState.summary: Server-authoritative counts and posting gates; current page never supplies batch totals.
clientState.selection: Group actions send selection.mode=all with issueVersion, independent of visible members.

complexBenchmark.environment: isolated local MySQL 8.4, Node 24, 256 MiB V8; synthetic only; not cloud or device timing
complexBenchmark.correctness: same transaction cumulative refund check; original links and evidence preserved; full mapping groups retain decisions/versions; same-user writes serialize and other users remain independent

rules: Current user only; posted and undone history; createdAt UTC descending plus updateId; signed user-scoped keyset cursor; pageSize 1..40 (default 20); no raw bill rows.

Without evidenceId, the JSON-text event includes optional detailFacts v1: current-user account names, confirmed/pending/unlinked refund originals and associated repayment loan name, read in the same snapshot. It uses current projected account endpoints; fieldSources and internal UTC metadata are not exposed. Evidence text and existing 2048-character paging remain unchanged; non-evidence cursors bind the detail-facts shape. This read never posts a transaction or creates a plan.

economicEvents.list.installment: Recognized credit-statement installment events include compact installment metadata {creditStatement:true,factKind:billing,component,periodNumber,totalTerms,originKind}; raw references and contract labels are not exposed in this projection. Principal billing is a source fact, not an actual transfer or repayment. Sources become available for explicit plan association after atomic posting.
economicEvents.list.excludedGroups: view=excluded_groups returns items[{groupId,key,label,note,count,sortLocalAt}] and total group count for the entire filtered batch. Only account_mapping_excluded or source_account_ignored_default groups use the normalized source account; missing account names fall back to the account-exclusion group. Other events group by actual exclusion reason: non-financial, closed, failed, individually excluded, or unknown. A payment account label alone never makes an account-exclusion group. Automatic reasons can group across accounts; account exclusion and automatic exclusion for the same account stay separate. Grouping version participates in the view version and cursor scope. status=excluded plus excludedGroupId pages only that group's transactions with total transaction count; each event carries actual reasonCodes and primaryEvidence.status from the source bill. Known exclusion reasons and source status survive oversized-event fallback. Both views share version, user, update, query and cursor isolation; summaries never contain member ID arrays or source text.
economicEvents.list.pendingIssues: review_pending and category_pending count and page transactions, including every member of multi-event issues. Each event carries pendingIssue (compact current open issue metadata, or null). One bounded query loads eligible issues for current-page events only; candidates, other-user/update members, closed issues and non-blocking review issues are excluded. review_pending selects the first actually available issue by dependency priority: status/identity/core conflicts and missing core facts, account prerequisites needed for matching, same-event/history matching, nature, ownership/accounts, allocations, refund and installment relations; equal priority keeps created_at and issue_id order. category_pending retains its original earliest category issue. Search never shrinks the full original decision scope.
economicEvents.list.reviewAttention: review_pending additionally returns reviewAttention {version:review-attention-v1,issueId,steps:[{key,label}]}. The first task matches pendingIssue; the rest are deduplicated known gaps from the current event plus real eligible issues, never the union of other members' reasons or invented future issues. Missing nature is one task, not an additional fixed label. Known nature and tasks render on the card left; the right only says 处理 with a chevron. No arrows imply forced serial steps. Principal billing never becomes actual repayment or a compulsory plan task. A fresh view recomputes tasks and entry together; the projection version participates in view/cursor identity. Oversized-event fallback retains both objects. Missing/mismatched summary falls back to the real current entry. This read does not create issues or transactions, change posting gates, or count category tasks as blockers.

financeUpdates.options.categoryHierarchy: Category options include parentId and parentName; query matches both parent and child names. Paging remains version-bound and user-scoped. Both levels can be selected; client opens this full directory instead of searching only the loaded candidate subset.

financeUpdates.summary.pairingSuggestedCount: Non-negative integer count of bidirectionally unique bank/channel pairs sharing an open same_event issue with bank_channel_same_event_candidate reason. Reuses the summary's event, issue-member and evidence reads and the paging graph rules, without changing viewVersion. The client applies every fresh summary even when viewVersion is unchanged; only a missing field falls back to the existing bounded pairings read. Invalid values remain an explicit entry error.

imports.parseFile.isolation: a failed file parse changes only that import file and never rolls back or mutates sibling files

bankMapping.statementKind: standard | credit; default standard unless the file explicitly identifies a credit-card statement. Principal-only installment treatment additionally requires a server-verified credit account.
bankMapping.headerRow: physical spreadsheet row / CSV logical record, 1..120
bankMapping.headerToken: server fingerprint bound to file, sheet and original header
bankMapping.debitDirection: income | expense explicitly selected for debit/credit values

imports.parseFile.bankPreview: Optional {sheetIndex,headerRow} requests a new bounded preview. Without bankMapping, bank files return mappingRequired with sheet names, headers, two sample rows and inferred columns; no batch or transaction is created. Owner-only response, not stored in mutation receipts.
imports.parseFile.retry: BANK_MAPPING_REQUIRED and BANK_ROWS_INVALID keep the owner-bound uploaded object. fileID may be omitted once bound. Invalid bank rows fail that entire file. Confirmed column interpretation participates in parse fingerprint and statement analysis; business writes still require financeUpdates.post.

imports.getFile.rowPolicy: Each source row appears once in cursor order; parsed rows do not create draft events or old per-row decisions.

rules: Preview uses current active created import transactions, including category edits; previewToken freezes current versions. Undo rechecks token, origin, dependencies, balances and audited side effects; reused transactions are retained.

rules: Compute degrees on complete eligible bank/platform graph before pagination or issue filtering; suggested pairs require degree one at both ends. No writes from preview.

Scope and cursors bind trusted user, update, view, dataRevision and full candidate digest; request page never establishes uniqueness. Source previews remain bounded; original evidence uses existing segmented reads.

data: selection.mode=all_except with excludedPairKeys (<=500) OR include with pairs[{pairKey,decision=same|distinct}] (1..100)
rules: At most 100 disjoint pairs in one all-or-nothing user-lock transaction; no public single-command loop. Recheck identities, source facts, active accounts, occupation, scope and versions.

all_except freezes full suggested range. Continuation is signed and refers to the original finance action; only unchanged remaining facts survive own acknowledged version advancement. External revision or candidate change requires explicit recheck.
Same merges draft events into platform primary, preserves evidence/refund references and never changes formal balances. Distinct rejects only the explicit pair.
Persist reliable source identity pairs plus necessary fact digest; no broad text/amount rules and no unreliable-identity replay. One range cleanup/count/receipt per batch, final client summary once.

Original request persisted before sending. Unknown results replay original requestId; trusted continuation saved before a new batch request; preserve partial progress, local intent and refresh failures.

Only an active, already categorized income/expense/fee event in a review batch can be changed. The selected category must be active, owned by the same user and compatible with the event nature. Change only this event and mark its category as manual; preserve other fields, issues, source evidence and formal ledger.
仅review批次内已核对的有效事件可修改economicNature、ledgerAccountId、counterpartyLedgerAccountId；未决阻断、组合付款及专用贷款还款走原处理入口。类型变化同步重验分类与退款关系，保留来源，不写正式账目。
Preview only the selected event source groups. Exact shared source identity and active formal transaction links cannot be split into extra transactions. No writes on read.

Only review batches; revalidate source groups and both versions under the user lock. Move original evidence without copying identities, preserve primary edits and saved origin fields, restore independent events and required follow-up reviews. Recheck affected refund relations. Correct only selected source-pair memories. No formal ledger writes. Unknown results replay the exact request.

A previous explicit distinct bank/platform pair may be changed to same after revalidating both events and all current pairing facts. A manually linked historical duplicate may reopen historical review; the original formal transaction and exact-source automatic duplicates remain protected.

rules.identity: uid and WeChat OpenID are server-only; identity-shaped client fields are rejected recursively
rules.upload: the server issues an opaque user-scoped cloudPath and parse only accepts the exact registered object path
rules.money: source decimal text is converted to minor-unit decimal strings without JavaScript floating point
rules.evidence: files, per-file parse batches, FinanceUpdate, Evidence, EconomicEvent, Relation, ReviewIssue, FinanceAction and formal Transaction remain separate; issue.subject.primaryEvidence includes masked original paymentMethod and optional source status for account confirmation
rules.parseUpgrade: same unposted file bytes reuse a batch only for an equal parse-run-v2 fingerprint; changed parser or interpretation versions append a batch and preserve prior evidence. A core interpretation change may reuse an identity only with the same file digest, source locator, identity anchor digest and unchanged amount/currency/direction; conflicts from other file bytes remain blocked
rules.organization: same amount, nearby time or similar text creates candidates only; only a stable shared reference plus compatible core fields may auto-merge evidence
rules.postability: ready is server-derived after planning, every issue resolution and inside the posting transaction; clients cannot submit ready
rules.posting: one FinanceUpdate commits all ready formal transactions and evidence links in one MySQL transaction; one aggregate repayment EconomicEvent may project to multiple formal transfers only when positive unique liability-account allocations exactly conserve the event amount; any failure rolls the whole update back
rules.cashBalance: atomic posting may not create or deepen a negative cash balance; failure rolls back accounts, mappings, transactions, links and state together
rules.prePostingWriteBarrier: before financeUpdates.post, account creation and reusable mapping changes remain FinanceUpdate-scoped drafts; abandoning or a failed post leaves formal accounts, mappings, transactions, balances and reports unchanged
rules.paymentRules: recognized atomic payment methods may map to one account or be permanently ignored per user and source; an aggregate statement reference such as Alipay 花呗｜信用购 is never an account or reusable mapping and must be allocated to real liability accounts; temporary ignore never silently becomes a permanent rule
rules.lifecycle: Files and parse batches preserve source evidence. Replacing or abandoning an unposted FinanceUpdate atomically removes its derived events, evidence links, relations, review issues/members and account/mapping drafts, while retaining update/source summaries and action audit. Formal accounts, transactions, reusable mappings and source identities are unchanged. Storage-object cleanup remains best-effort.
rules.publicWritePath: The only posting implementation is financeUpdates.post. Legacy single-file services and their decision/posting/link tables are removed by migration 0012.
rules.idempotentReplay: 导入命令固定小型首次回执；幂等键/请求摘要持久保留。重复请求不重做，摘要另读。旧在途请求只核实原键，历史事实不足明确待核对；一次性离线转换不构成在线旧协议适配。

historicalDuplicateReview.candidate: Current-user live formal transactions, same bound funds account, equal amount, compatible direction, UTC within 48 hours; includes manual and other imported sources. Stable identity matches retain existing automatic reuse; similarity alone never merges.
historicalDuplicateReview.review: One same_event issue per current event, primaryReasonCode=historical_duplicate_candidate. Subject member is event; candidate members are transaction IDs with frozen versions. reviewIssues.members accepts memberKind=transaction and returns bounded transaction summaries, never another user’s records.
historicalDuplicateReview.decisions: confirm_distinct acknowledges the current complete candidate set. link_existing_transaction requires a current candidate of that issue; it creates an audited historical_primary link and excludes this event from new posting. Target changes invalidate the decision. Repeated requests are idempotent.
historicalDuplicateReview.lifecycle: prepare, current-version organize and review mutations synchronize candidates. Restoring a review and advancing the page recheck history. Posting always rechecks under the same user lock; new or changed candidates cause HISTORY_REVIEW_REQUIRED and full rollback. Client retains drafts and returns to review.
historicalDuplicateReview.limits: At most 10000 matching event/transaction pairs per scan; excess returns HISTORY_MATCH_LIMIT_EXCEEDED before any financial write. Candidates use existing signed version/user-scoped member pagination.
historicalDuplicateReview.counts: already_posted and linked_existing_transaction excluded events appear under duplicate, separately from deliberate user exclusions. No duplicate financial writes or changes to history.
